ox.conversation.delete.description: Permanently delete another conversation in the active Profile: `await ox.conversation.delete({ purpose, id })`. Find conversation IDs with ox.fs.list at conversations/. Requires approval unless its Action policy is Allow. Cannot delete the calling conversation. Deletes its conversation-owned files and blobs as well. Files moved into shared Profile folders survive. References from other conversations do not transfer ownership and become unavailable when the owning file is deleted.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.conversation.model.description: Read this conversation's current model, provider, tool support, and authentication readiness: `await ox.conversation.model({ purpose })`. Returns status only, never credentials or account labels. Does not change the model. Includes thinkingLevel and the latest model change status: pending, applied, failed, or cancelled. The provider/model fields describe the active selection, not a pending target.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

model.description: Exact available picker model ID from ox.provider.get, not its wire ID.

thinkingLevel.description: Supported thinking level; null selects medium when supported, otherwise the model's lowest level. Omission preserves it for the same model.

ox.conversation.rename.description: Rename the current conversation when requested: `await ox.conversation.rename({ purpose, title })`. Use a concise title of at most 50 characters. Ox derives a default title from the conversation; ordinary tasks do not require a rename call. Titles set by the user or an import are preserved. Returns the current explicit title and whether it changed.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

title.description: A concise title of at most 50 characters describing the conversation's purpose.

ox.conversation.setModel.description: Change this conversation's model only when explicitly requested: `await ox.conversation.setModel({ purpose, selection: { provider, model, thinkingLevel? } })`. Use provider IDs from ox.provider.list, available picker model IDs from ox.provider.get, and existing authentication. Omitted thinkingLevel preserves it for the same model; null uses medium when supported, otherwise the model's lowest level. Returns normalized selection, changed, and status applied or pending. A pending change applies after this submission succeeds, before the next queued user turn; the current submission keeps its model. Stop, submission failure, conversation teardown, or a conflicting manual selection cancels it. Pending requests are not persisted or replayed after process exit. Read ox.conversation.model to confirm application or inspect failure; never call pending applied. A later explicit request replaces the pending target. Explain that subsequent turns can send this conversation's context to the selected provider. Does not change the new-conversation default, credentials, or provider definitions.

ox.conversation.start.description: Start an independent conversation in the active Profile: `await ox.conversation.start({ purpose, prompt, title? })`. Use for an independent task that benefits from fresh context. Returns its ID without waiting for the response or changing the selected conversation. Uses the default model; include all task instructions in prompt. Read its metadata and transcript with ox.fs at `conversations/<id>/{conversation.json,turns.jsonl}` before claiming completion. Loaded conversations expose current snapshots, including running/completed/failed/cancelled turn outcomes and pending prompts. A user-only transcript means work has not begun. The new conversation uses normal Action policies and may need user attention. Temporary conversations cannot start persisted conversations.
